name: core-vlm-barnegat-binary-pilot
task: classify a cropped modern sediment core photo as sand-dominated or fine-grained

source.name: USGS Data Series 985: Sediment Data Collected in 2014 from Barnegat Bay, New Jersey

external_transfer.prompt: same prompt as the adapter training manifest

evaluation.decision: Do not connect this adapter to the geologist-facing app. Independent Barnegat intervals showed no exact accuracy gain, and both external transfer sets fell below their majority-class baseline.

limitations: Pixel-to-depth mapping uses a provisional one-percent end margin and was not verified per photo.
Binary target labels were mapped from the first lithology term in the English logs and were not checked against every crop by a geologist.
Tiles from one source interval are correlated; tile-level accuracy overstates the amount of independent evidence.

Training used only modern Barnegat Bay sediments. External ancient R-41 and modern Cat Island binary transfer checks both failed their majority baselines; their crop labels are automatic and not geologist-approved.
Full Russian descriptions and depositional environments were not evaluated for this adapter.
The commercial DeepCore product database was not included. No public export was found.
